prompt:
Edit the referenced Zaichang study-paper design into a faithful, implementable desktop UI proposal for an explorable explanation INSIDE THE SAME STUDY PAPER, not a separate app or dashboard. Preserve the warm gray window light, quiet gold accents, authentic cotton paper grain, narrow left original-question paper, larger right working paper, and only one actual writing composer on the right paper. Existing selected companion can be a very small blue-haired girl cutout at the far right paper edge; she does not obscure mathematics.

Use real, legible Chinese and mathematically consistent content. Left narrow paper: source heading 微积分练习.md, quiet 看看原文, 这一题, original integral ∫ x cos(x²) dx. Never change this original problem into the graph example. Right heading 把这一步想通, quiet bookmark 先放一放. Two authentic learner-reported handwritten lines under 我想到这里: u=x², du=2x dx; next line x dx=½du. These remain in place. After them one short current authored explanation: 先用一小段二次关系，分清同一个点的两种读法。点的高度告诉我们这一处的位置，切线的倾斜告诉我们此刻往哪、变多快。 This is an explicitly illustrative example, not the original integral secretly changed.

Below that explanation embed a real coherent pencil/SVG-style coordinate graph of f(x)=a x². The graph lives directly on the paper, about 220 CSS px high, NOT in a rounded card. The current temporary choice is a=2, x=1. Display this in one natural sentence above the graph with only the two numbers delicately gold-underlined as editable text: 试着让 a = 2，在 x = 1 这一点看. The dark graphite current parabola is y=2x². A very quiet thin dashed gray original curve y=x² appears only as context, labelled 原条件 a=1 in tiny writing near its curve. Do not give it a competing legend or readout. Coordinate axes with restrained labels: x from -2 to 2, y from -1 to 8. One warm gold point at (1,2). A thin vertical graphite dashed guide from (1,0) to (1,2) makes the actual height legible. A short warm gold tangent passing through (1,2), slope 4; draw it correctly, e.g. from (.65,.6) to (1.35,3.4). A tiny point/handle on the x axis lets the reader drag x, no big control bars.

Immediately below the graph one ordinary linked-reading sentence, not tiles: 这一点的高度是 2，切线斜率是 4。切线向右上倾。 The values and graph are linked, but do not animate a static image or present a performance score. A very quiet text action 接着这个变化问 can attach this temporary hypothesis to the one composer. The author has provided an understandable explanation first; this is not a blank sandbox or an exam.

At bottom of the right paper retain ONE true writing area with natural handwritten placeholder 我接下来想到的是… and the existing small attachment/control icons plus a single gold send arrow. There is no second global chat composer. No mode badges, progress bars, mastery labels, engineering fields, charts dashboard, slider panel, lesson navigation, duplicate answers, fake PDF URL, or giant avatar. Keep the plotted point and tangent mathematically exact. Show the full pair of papers at comfortable desktop reading scale; it is fine for paper to extend vertically, but the graph, the two learner lines, explanation and one writing input must form one coherent working surface.
notes: Illustrative math and synthetic study content; no student personal facts or mastery claim.
Generated plot is design guidance only. Runtime point, curve, tangent and numbers must come from the same finite quadratic calculation.
Keep original question, learner reports, assistant explanation and temporary user-selected conditions distinct.
Do not change selected companion/presence preference to match the illustrative character.
